name: trace-prd
description: Every decision traced from intent to ship. Keeps a living PRD (TRACE.md) in sync with what you are actually building: logs each turn, proposes Decision Log, Assumption Ledger and Open Questions entries, and lets you accept or skip each one.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: Your own key, used only for background proposals after each turn. Stored in your OS credential store. Leave empty to generate proposals in-session with /trace-prd:review instead.

model.title: Background model
model.description: Model used for background proposals (three short calls per editing turn). Ignored when no API key is set.
